leads.title: Product Manager — DeFi Products & Applications
leads.snippet: About the Role We're looking for a Product Manager to own and drive DeFi products spanning liquid staking, token launch infrastructure, and on-chain payment rails. You'll work at the intersection of protocol design, tokenomics, DeFi integrations, and regulatory strategy — translating complex on-chain mechanics into products that users trust and adopt. This is a high-ownership role for someone who understands DeFi deeply and can move fluidly between smart contract mechanics, liquidity strategy, partnership development, and go-to-market execution. leads.title: Data Engineer
leads.snippet: As a Data Engineer at PERGOLUX , you will build and own the data pipelines that enable fast, reliable operational insights across the business. Your work ensures the company can trust its data, automate confidently, and make high-impact decisions in real time. You will join a lean, senior data team where reliability, clarity, and business value—not technical complexity—define success. At PERGOLUX , we combine Scandinavian-inspired design with a collaborative, ambitious culture grounded in integrity, innovation, and unity. leads.snippet: Intro Die CKM Group bündelt Expertise aus verschiedenen Bereichen, um Fortschritt und Innovation in der Gesundheitsversorgung voranzutreiben. Unser Zusammenschluss aus Klinik, Labor, telemedizinischem Service und IT-Unternehmen steht für die Entwicklung moderner und effektiver Lösungen im Gesundheitswesen. Unser Ziel ist es, durch präventive Dienstleistungsmedizin, eHealth und Public Health eine führende und wegweisende Rolle im Gesundheitssystem von morgen einzunehmen.
